notes: Corrected: the doubled דֶּרֶךְ דֶּרֶךְ is not a repetition the ASV renders once. The absolute הַדֶּרֶךְ takes *the way* and the construct דֶּרֶךְ takes *toward*, leaving the rectum הַצָּפוֹן with *north* alone. The accepted alignment marked the construct unrepresented and gave *toward* to the rectum under rule 19; that reading rests on rule 22, which governs an element the ASV renders only once, whereas here each דֶּרֶךְ has its own English word.

The correction also brings this verse into line with the chapter's other דֶּרֶךְ הַ- phrases (42.7, 42.10, 42.12, 42.15), where the construct דֶּרֶךְ itself carries *toward*; the last clause of this verse shows the contrasting pattern, where אֶל carries *toward* and the article and noun take their own words.
Both נֶגֶד clauses are prepositional predicates, so the supplied *was* joins the preposition under rule 49, headed on *over*.
